scope: Independent arithmetic/cohort verification of14 specified DEFAULT128 facets only; not complete all-K/all-dataset/all-policy campaign validation
scoring_method: Each channel independently: cast only observed prediction/target cells toFP64, sum squared/absolute errors, divide by its own observed count, then equal-channel arithmetic macro using math.fsum. Canonical reference predictions drive reported accuracy; regenerated predictions are separately recomputed and parity-checked
timing_method: Direct median of20 saved timed whole_seconds*1000 perfacet; allocated memory is the maximum20 timed peak_allocated_MiB values. Two-seed summary averages facet metrics, not raw trials pooled across seeds
positive_rule: Both B2 seeds MSE strictly below Raw, two-seed mean MSE at least1% below Raw, and each seed DEFAULT128 latency median and allocated peak strictly below Raw. MAE and Direct dominance remain visible and are not silently added to/removed from that rule

appliances.source_scoring_scope: Fresh A60-normalized full registered V origins, observed equal-channel macro; no new TEST access

ETTh1.source_scoring_scope: Fresh A60-normalized full registered V origins, observed equal-channel macro; no new TEST access

limitations: These are adaptively explored development V results, not independent untouched TEST confirmation or statistical significance
Only the requested AppliancesK4/7/14, ETTh1K4, and their Raw/Direct DEFAULT128 facets were checked; ETTh2, ETTh1K1/K2 and COMMON_CAP are outside this supplemental scope
Two optimization seeds and20 technical timing repetitions do not establish a confidence interval or production tail-latency guarantee
Allocated CUDA tensor memory is not a hard process-memory budget; timing numbers were recomputed from saved trials rather than newly measured
No source checkpoint/model tensor replay or training rerun was performed; recorded checkpoint SHA values are preserved from receipts but checkpoint files were not opened by this task
FP32 canonical predictions and targets were rescored withFP64 arithmetic; this does not recover pre-FP32 rounding precision
Appliances upstream hourly-to-ten-minute interpolation ancestry and ETTh1-family prior development/pretraining exposure remain inherited limitations
